claims.assertion: Yazhi said dry pods print replacement tissue onto mapped damage and work faster but may cause side effects; wet pods use cultured patient stem cells, take longer, and are preferred.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu

claims.assertion: Yazhi said wet pods can regenerate lost limbs and repair organs if the patient is stable enough; full-body renewal takes about three months.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu

claims.assertion: Yazhi said pods can repair physical conditions, but illnesses tied to recurring thought patterns may return unless those underlying causes change.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She said Anéeka had not tried a pod.
